hint.bright: Very bright pixels wear fastest. Dim this colour or use a thinner font weight.
hint.dynamic: This content changes often, so the estimate drops as sampling continues.
hint.horizontal: Horizontal shifting never blurs horizontal edges. Allow vertical shift, or soften the edge.
hint.outside: Not part of the bar, for example a window border. Pixel Shift cannot move it.
hint.static: Stays put even with shifting. A wider range for this group helps.
hint.wide: Shifting cannot blur a solid fill this wide. Lower its opacity or use an outline style.

lab.allow_vertical_note: Moves the bar 1–2 px up and down. It blinks briefly every 30 min; windows keep their size.
lab.anchored: The {widget} widget is anchored, so the center group cannot move. Set anchor = false on it to let Pixel Shift shift the center.
lab.approximate: The measurement was noisy, so these results are approximate. Check the spacer placement, then measure again.
lab.curve_title: Risk for each amount of movement
lab.glow_legend: glow = where a ghost would form
lab.movement: Movement per spacer · 1 px every {minutes} min

moves_nothing.one: One spacer moves nothing. Spacers move widgets only from the outer edge of a section: first in the start section, first or last in the center, last in the end section.
moves_nothing.other: {count} spacers move nothing. Spacers move widgets only from the outer edge of a section: first in the start section, first or last in the center, last in the end section.

lab.no_grim: grim is not installed. Pixel Shift needs it to measure the bar.
lab.no_hotspots: No hotspots left. The strongest remaining spot reaches {worst} of 100.

onboarding.body: Spacers are invisible widgets. Pixel Shift changes their width over the day, which moves the widgets next to them by a few pixels.
onboarding.steps:
1. Open the bar settings and add the **Pixel Shift** spacer widget.
2. Put one at the **start of the left section**, one at the **end of the right section**, and one on **each side of the center section**.
3. Come back here: Pixel Shift measures the bar and finds the best strategy by itself.
onboarding.title: Add Pixel Shift spacers to your bar

lab.optimizing_note: Runs in small slices between frames, so the shell stays responsive.
lab.paused: Paused: the bar is not shifting.
lab.pick_note: At {px} px the risk drops to {score} (no shift: {none}). {more} px more would save only {save}.
lab.pick_note_flat: At {px} px the risk drops to {score} (no shift: {none}); more movement would not lower it.
lab.pick_note_last: At {px} px, the most movement allowed, the risk drops to {score} (no shift: {none}).
lab.pick_note_tail: Re-optimizes when the bar changes and every night.

placement.center: Make {widget} the first or last item of the bar's center section.
placement.end: Make {widget} the last item of the bar's end section, or it cannot move anything.
placement.start: Make {widget} the first item of the bar's start section, or it cannot move anything.

lab.revert_tip: Back to the strategy that was live before
lab.scale_end: 100 = a white line that never moves
lab.scanning: Measuring the bar. It twitches for a moment.
lab.title: Burn-in Lab
lab.vertical_error: Vertical shift had no effect (a GUI setting overrides it) and was turned off.

view_note.ghost: What it would leave on a grey screen

panel_profile.description: Which OLED technology your screen uses. Changes how much each colour channel wears.

sample_minutes.description: How often the bar is captured to learn what it shows over the day.
